question: Under which article of the Indian constitution is the Prime Minister the head of the Council of Ministers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 74(1) **states that** "There shall be a Council of Ministers with the Prime Minister at the head to aid and advise the President who shall, in the exercise of his functions, act in accordance with such advice."**
 
• **Therefore, Article 74 establishes the Council of Ministers with the Prime Minister as its head. **
 
• The Prime Minister provides advice to the President, who acts in accordance with that advice while performing their functions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 52 of the Indian Constitution pertains to the position of the President of India**.

 
 
• "There shall be a President of India who shall be the Head of State and exercise powers, duties, and functions in accordance with the Constitution and shall be vested with all powers relating to the executive, including the powers enumerated in the Constitution."
 
• **Article 52** establishes the President as the **Head of State in India.**
 
• It outlines that the President holds powers, duties, and functions as per the Constitution and is vested with executive powers, including those specifically mentioned in the Constitution.
 
• **The President **is the highest constitutional authority in the country.
